```{r}
#| output: asis

verbs <- read.csv("verben.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

verb_to_json <- function(r) {
  sprintf(paste0('{"infinitive":"%s","auxiliary":"%s","participle":"%s",',
                 '"wrongAux":"%s","wrongP1":"%s","wrongP2":"%s",',
                 '"beforeAux":"%s","beforeParticiple":"%s","afterParticiple":"%s"}'),
          r[["infinitive"]], r[["auxiliary"]], r[["participle"]],
          r[["wrong_aux"]], r[["wrong_p1"]], r[["wrong_p2"]],
          r[["before_aux"]], r[["before_participle"]], r[["after_participle"]])}

json_verbs <- paste0("[",
                     paste(apply(verbs, 1, verb_to_json), collapse = ","),
                     "]")

cat(sprintf("<script>const VERBS = %s;</script>\n", json_verbs))
```

```{=html}

<div class="screen" id="game-screen">

  <div class="game-header">
    <span class="game-title">Perfekt</span>
    <span class="game-subtitle">Verben · Deutsch</span>
  </div>

  <div class="scorebar">
    <div class="score-item">
      <span class="sc-label">Richtig</span>
      <span class="sc-val correct" id="val-correct">0</span>
    </div>
    <div class="score-divider"></div>
    <div class="score-item">
      <span class="sc-label">Streak 🔥</span>
      <span class="sc-val streak"  id="val-streak">0</span>
    </div>
    <div class="score-divider"></div>
    <div class="score-item">
      <span class="sc-label">Falsch</span>
      <span class="sc-val wrong"   id="val-wrong">0</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="progress-wrap">
    <div class="progress-bar" id="progress-bar" style="width:0%"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="verb-card" id="verb-card">
    <span class="verb-infinitive" id="verb-infinitive">…</span>

    <div class="sentence-wrap" id="sentence-wrap">
      <!-- Built dynamically by JS -->
    </div>

    <div class="correct-sentence" id="correct-sentence"></div>
  </div>

  <button class="next-btn" id="next-btn" onclick="nextVerb()">
    weiter →
  </button>

</div>

<div class="screen hidden" id="end-screen">

  <p class="end-title">Fertig!</p>
  <p class="end-sub">Perfekt gemeistert</p>

  <span class="end-score" id="end-score">0</span>
  <p class="end-total"    id="end-total">von 0 Verben</p>
  <p class="end-msg"      id="end-msg"></p>

  <div class="end-actions">
    <button class="replay-btn" onclick="restartGame()">Nochmal spielen ↺</button>
  </div>

</div>

<script>
let deck     = [];
let current  = null;
let phase    = 'aux';
let correct  = 0;
let wrong    = 0;
let streak   = 0;
let total    = 0;
let hadError = false;

function shuffle(arr) {
  for (let i = arr.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    [arr[i], arr[j]] = [arr[j], arr[i]];
  }
  return arr;
}

function show(id) {
  ['game-screen', 'end-screen'].forEach(s =>
    document.getElementById(s).classList.toggle('hidden', s !== id)
  );
}

function updateScore() {
  document.getElementById('val-correct').textContent = correct;
  document.getElementById('val-wrong').textContent   = wrong;
  document.getElementById('val-streak').textContent  = streak;
}

function updateProgress() {
  const pct = VERBS.length ? (total / VERBS.length) * 100 : 0;
  document.getElementById('progress-bar').style.width = pct + '%';
}

function buildSentence(verb) {
  const wrap = document.getElementById('sentence-wrap');
  wrap.innerHTML = '';

  function textSpan(t) {
    const s = document.createElement('span');
    s.className   = 'sent-text';
    s.textContent = t;
    return s;
  }

  function choiceStack(options, type) {
    const stack = document.createElement('div');
    stack.className   = 'choice-stack';
    stack.dataset.type = type;

    options.forEach(opt => {
      const btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.className   = 'choice-btn';
      btn.textContent = opt;
      btn.dataset.value = opt;
      btn.dataset.type  = type;
      if (type === 'aux') {
        btn.classList.add(
          opt === 'haben' ? 'haben-style' : 'sein-style'
        );
        btn.onclick = () => guessAux(opt);
      } else {
        btn.onclick = () => guessParticiple(opt);
      }
      stack.appendChild(btn);
    });

    return stack;
  }

  const auxOpts = shuffle([verb.auxiliary, verb.wrongAux]);

  const partOpts = shuffle([verb.participle, verb.wrongP1, verb.wrongP2]);

  if (verb.beforeAux)        wrap.appendChild(textSpan(verb.beforeAux));
  wrap.appendChild(choiceStack(auxOpts, 'aux'));
  if (verb.beforeParticiple) wrap.appendChild(textSpan(verb.beforeParticiple));

  const pStack = choiceStack(partOpts, 'participle');
  pStack.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b => { b.disabled = true; });
  wrap.appendChild(pStack);

  if (verb.afterParticiple)  wrap.appendChild(textSpan(verb.afterParticiple));
}

function guessAux(chosen) {
  if (phase !== 'aux') return;

  const wrap    = document.getElementById('sentence-wrap');
  const auxBtns = [...wrap.querySelectorAll('.choice-btn[data-type="aux"]')];
  const partBtns = [...wrap.querySelectorAll('.choice-btn[data-type="participle"]')];

  auxBtns.forEach(b => { b.disabled = true; });

  if (chosen === current.auxiliary) {
    auxBtns.forEach(b => {
      b.classList.add(b.dataset.value === chosen ? 'state-correct' : 'state-dim');
    });
    partBtns.forEach(b => { b.disabled = false; });
    phase = 'participle';
  } else {

    hadError = true;
    wrong++;
    streak = 0;
    auxBtns.forEach(b => {
      if (b.dataset.value === chosen)          b.classList.add('state-wrong');
      else if (b.dataset.value === current.auxiliary) b.classList.add('state-reveal');
      else                                     b.classList.add('state-dim');
    });
    
    setTimeout(() => {
      partBtns.forEach(b => { b.disabled = false; });
      phase = 'participle';
    }, 800);
    updateScore();
    return;
  }
  updateScore();
}

function guessParticiple(chosen) {
  if (phase !== 'participle') return;
  phase = 'done';
  total++;

  const wrap     = document.getElementById('sentence-wrap');
  const partBtns = [...wrap.querySelectorAll('.choice-btn[data-type="participle"]')];
  const card     = document.getElementById('verb-card');
  const corrSent = document.getElementById('correct-sentence');

  partBtns.forEach(b => { b.disabled = true; });

  if (chosen === current.participle) {
    // Correct participle
    partBtns.forEach(b => {
      b.classList.add(b.dataset.value === chosen ? 'state-correct' : 'state-dim');
    });

    if (!hadError) {
      // Perfect round
      correct++;
      streak++;
    } else {
      showCorrectSentence();
    }
  } else {
    hadError = true;
    wrong++;
    streak = 0;
    partBtns.forEach(b => {
      if (b.dataset.value === chosen)             b.classList.add('state-wrong');
      else if (b.dataset.value === current.participle) b.classList.add('state-reveal');
      else                                        b.classList.add('state-dim');
    });
    card.classList.add('shake');
    setTimeout(() => card.classList.remove('shake'), 450);
    showCorrectSentence();
  }

  updateScore();
  updateProgress();
  document.getElementById('next-btn').classList.add('visible');
}

function showCorrectSentence() {
  const el = document.getElementById('correct-sentence');
  el.textContent =
    current.beforeAux +
    current.auxiliary +
    current.beforeParticiple +
    current.participle +
    current.afterParticiple;
  el.classList.add('show');
}

function loadVerb() {
  if (deck.length === 0) { showEnd(); return; }
  current  = deck.pop();
  phase    = 'aux';
  hadError = false;

  document.getElementById('verb-infinitive').textContent = current.infinitive;
  document.getElementById('correct-sentence').textContent = '';
  document.getElementById('correct-sentence').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('next-btn').classList.remove('visible');

  buildSentence(current);
}

function nextVerb() { loadVerb(); }

function restartGame() {
  deck    = shuffle([...VERBS]);
  correct = 0; wrong = 0; streak = 0; total = 0;
  updateScore();
  updateProgress();
  show('game-screen');
  loadVerb();
}

function showEnd() {
  const pct   = VERBS.length ? Math.round((correct / VERBS.length) * 100) : 0;
  const msg   = pct === 100 ? 'Ausgezeichnet! Perfekt gemeistert.'
              : pct >= 80   ? 'Sehr gut! Fast perfekt.'
              : pct >= 60   ? 'Gut! Weiter üben.'
              :               'Weitermachen — du schaffst das!';

  document.getElementById('end-score').textContent = correct;
  document.getElementById('end-total').textContent = 'von ' + VERBS.length + ' Verben';
  document.getElementById('end-msg').textContent   = msg;
  show('end-screen');
}

restartGame();
</script>
```
